title: Effective Teacher Support for Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14850v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forward-KL language-model distillation normally computes dense teacher and student scores over the full vocabulary at every supervised position, making training and stored teacher targets expensive. We instead distill from the teacher's highest-probability vocabulary fraction, renormalizing the retained mass as we sweep support from 100% to 0.01%. Our main study distills Qwen3 4B -> 1.7B. We confirm the broader support-reduction finding on larger Qwen3 8B -> 4B and Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B pairs and under answer-only supervision. We evaluate generation primarily on MMLU-Pro and secondarily on GPQA-Diamond. Across the Qwen3 settings, retaining 0.01% of the vocabulary causes no observed MMLU-Pro degradation relative to full-vocabulary distillation, although disagreement with the complete teacher distribution increases. translated_title: 面向推理蒸馏的有效教师分布支撑集
translated_abstract: 前向KL散度的语言模型蒸馏通常需要在每个监督位置上对完整词表计算稠密的教师和学生分数，这使得训练以及教师软标签的存储成本十分高昂。我们转而从教师模型中概率最高的部分词表进行蒸馏，并在将支撑集从100%逐步缩减至0.01%的过程中对保留的概率质量进行重新归一化。我们的主要实验是将Qwen3 4B蒸馏至1.7B，并在更大的Qwen3 8B -> 4B与Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B模型对上、以及在仅监督答案（answer-only）的设置下，验证了支撑集缩减这一更为广泛的结论。我们主要在MMLU-Pro上评估生成质量，其次在GPQA-Diamond上进行评估。在所有Qwen3设置中，仅保留0.01%的词表与完整词表蒸馏相比，在MMLU-Pro上未观察到性能下降，尽管其与完整教师分布的分歧有所增加。Nemotron Nano在保留0.1%词表时即可达到与完整词表相当的MMLU-Pro性能，但更小的比例会导致模型无法输出结束推理标签，此结果表明……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现在前向KL散度的推理蒸馏中，只需保留教师分布中概率最高的极小部分词表（如0.01%）并重新归一化，即可在MMLU-Pro等基准上取得与完整词表蒸馏相当的性能，从而大幅降低训练成本与教师软标签的存储开销。
en_tdlr: Distilling from only the top 0.01% of the teacher's vocabulary (with renormalized mass) matches full-vocabulary Forward-KL distillation on MMLU-Pro, drastically reducing training and teacher-target storage costs for reasoning distillation.
